mapper.sql: select id, biz_type, biz_id, submitter_id, source_type, risk_level, status, current_assignee, submitted_at, deadline_at, snapshot_json, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from audit_task
mapper.select: where biz_id = #{topicId} and biz_type in ('TOPIC', 'TOPIC_PROJECT_REVIEW', 'TOPIC_SALE_REVIEW') and status in (0, 3) order by id for update
where biz_id = #{topicId} and biz_type in ('TOPIC', 'TOPIC_PROJECT_REVIEW', 'TOPIC_SALE_REVIEW') order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update audit_task set status = 4, risk_level = 'SUPPLY_REPLACEMENT', version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and status in (0, 3) and biz_type in ('TOPIC', 'TOPIC_PROJECT_REVIEW', 'TOPIC_SALE_REVIEW')
mapper.select: where biz_type = #{bizType} and biz_id = #{bizId} and status in (0, 3) and not (source_type <=> 'report' and biz_type in ('TOPIC', 'TEMPLATE', 'TEMPLATE_LIBRARY', 'ACTIVITY')) order by id desc limit 1 for update
order by submitted_at desc, id desc
order by deadline_at is null, deadline_at asc, submitted_at asc, id asc

mapper.select: select count(*) from audit_task where status = 0 and submitted_at < #{cutoff}
select count(*) from audit_task where status = 0 and deadline_at is not null and deadline_at < #{now}
select count(distinct r.operator_id) from audit_record r join audit_task t on t.id = r.task_id where t.biz_type = #{bizType} and t.biz_id = #{bizId} and t.status in (0, 3) and r.action = 'REPORT'
mapper.update: update audit_task set risk_level = #{riskLevel}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in (0, 3) and risk_level <=> #{expectedRiskLevel}
